$comment: Example deployment tool map for the Agent Receipts cross-SDK vectors. action.type names a class of action, not a resource or an effect class, so these entries are the verifier's reading, not the Agent Receipts spec. Where a receipt carries action.target.resource, the resource comes from it; data.api.read and system.command.execute receipts in the vectors carry no target, so their resource is fixed per action type for the worked cases.
